# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release on `main` receives security and dependency fixes.

## Report a vulnerability

Do not report security problems in public issues or pull requests.

Report them privately through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/andrew-abdelmalak/2-dof-robotic-arm-control-system/security/advisories/new).

Include:

- The affected commit, release tag, or firmware sketch
- Steps to reproduce or a minimal proof of concept
- Expected impact

## What happens next

We will review the report, confirm whether the issue reproduces in the verification suite or firmware build, and coordinate a fix on `main` before public disclosure.
